$comment: Decides which crawled files survive. GlobCompiler (this stage's dependency, semantics-neutral) compiles per-node state from glob sources under Ignore or Selection semantics; Invoke-Filter applies two eligibility GUARDS first (MaxSizeBytes, extension blacklist — crawler metadata, no I/O, NOT glob semantics, do not invert), then the glob verdict. Takes a SLICE of crawler.out (the `from` fields below); rebuilds nodes with its own shape (out.node) and keeps file descriptors as the same objects (out.file = crawler.out.file). Anything in crawler.out.node not in out.node — the subtree rollups — is reachable downstream only by joining filter.out ⋈ crawler.out on NodePath (the orchestrator retains crawler.out). Fails fast if a descriptor lacks RelativePath or Extension.

GlobSemantics.note: compiler; what a glob match MEANS — Ignore: match = excluded (sentinels + virtual root ignore file); Selection: match = kept (user globs only, no sentinel I/O, no dir pruning). Params of the other semantics are inert. reports/ignore-semantics-update.md

IgnorePatterns.note: compiler, Ignore only; virtual root ignore file

IgnoreOverridePatterns.note: compiler, Ignore only; merged as negations into the same virtual file

SentinelFileNames.note: compiler, Ignore only; default ['.gitignore', '.snapignore']; read from disk by AbsolutePath

ExtensionBlacklist.note: GUARD (Invoke-Filter); ADDITIVE to the hard blacklist, never replaces it → Skipped ExtensionBlacklisted. The hard list (images, media, archives, compiled, office docs, fonts, data blobs) is $script:HardExtensionBlacklist in the module — reposnapshot has no business ingesting binary blobs under either semantics; a plain data list awaiting a run-config home (defaults.filter.extensionBlacklist)

Files.note: surviving descriptors — same objects as crawler.out.file, filtered

CompiledState.note: @{ Semantics; Positives; Exceptions } — semantics-stamped compiled glob state for the node; TestPath interprets it
